elements.desc: A middle-aged bald man with a neatly trimmed black beard and black-rimmed glasses, wearing a burgundy blazer over a white t-shirt, holding a black tablet and raising his left hand showing three fingers, with a silver ring.
A textured ribbed yellow throw pillow visible on the burgundy velvet couch.
